SWINGBY ULTRA pack (4 presets) - SEVENTHWELL

Ultra Saw     LEAD  festival supersaw: 3 stacks of 8 (one a hard-sync table), +1 / -1 octave, Drive, limiter pushed. Mod wheel: wider.
Ultra Bass    BASS  dubstep growl: sine sub + FM growl (mono low end), folded and formant tables (wide mids). LFO 1/8; mod wheel: 1/16.
Ultra Wobble  BASS  classic wobble: resonant 24 dB filters opened by a 1/8 triangle over ~7 octaves, sine sub. Mod wheel: 1/16.
Ultra Riddim  BASS  riddim: square + hard FM, chopped by the trance gate on 1/16, random FM brightness per 1/8. Mod wheel: more drive.

All levelled to -16 LUFS like the factory presets. The LFOs and the gate follow the host tempo.

Install: copy the .swpreset files to
  Windows: Documents\SEVENTHWELL\SWINGBY\Presets\
  macOS:   ~/Library/Audio/Presets/SEVENTHWELL/SWINGBY/
then open the SWINGBY window (or reopen it): they are under USER (and LEAD / BASS) in the preset list.
